item.title: Local students named to Missouri State University’s Fall 2025 Dean’s List
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, MO - Each semester, students at Missouri State University who attain academic excellence are named to the dean’s list.

item.title: Bunceton participates in science fair
item.description: Five schools in the Show-Me Conference held their Science Fair on January 20th. Schools participating were Bunceton, Calvary Lutheran, Jamestown, Prairie Home, and Vienna. Eight Bunceton students were awarded ribbons on their science fair projects. Tah’Naiya Clark received a blue ribbon for “Does Food Coloring Have Taste?” in the Junior High Behavior Science division. item.title: Kiwanis Chili Day served hundreds
item.description: Cold temperatures didn’t deter as diners followed their noses as the smell of ground beef and chili powder wafted out of the doors of Saints Peter & Paul Catholic Church Wednesday January 28, for the Boonville Kiwanis Club’s Annual Chili Day fundraiser.
